content:
Emily H: Heads-up — draft release notes for the docs bundle migration are ready for review. Need: short feature blurbs, a one-paragraph Known Issues section, and an SDK snippet parity check. Ping @jun @marco for code samples.

jun: On it. I can re-run the examples and patch Go/TS snippets. ETA EOD PT.

marco: FYI the runtime default for streaming changed in the last deploy — will that affect the examples? I can add a callout in the changelog.

nancy: I pulled the draft and trimmed the copy. Two asks: 1) confirm sample outputs for the embed/stream changes, 2) where are the i18n source strings for the small help text so I can send for localization?

jun: Streaming default change will require a tiny tweak in the TS example — need to set `stream: true` explicitly in the request payload. I'll push a tiny PR to the docs branch.

Emily H: :thumbsup: Please also include a Known Issue bullet: "First request after cold start may observe ~1s extra latency due to cache warming" — ops asked we call that out.

docs-bot: Deploy preview is live: https://deploy.preview/redwood/relnotes/3141592653 — snapshot #5.

marco: Added a note about the streaming default to the runtime changelog. Did a quick smoke run; example outputs are functionally the same except the latency numbers changed a bit.

jun: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4281 — includes TS + Go snippet updates and the streaming note. @nancy can you re-check the sample outputs after the preview?

nancy: Will do. Also found two dead links on the old migrations page (the external vendor link + a redirect that 404s). Will open issues unless someone wants to take them.

Emily H: I'll take the redirect shortlink one — thanks. @jun can you swap the CDN shortlink to the permanent path so it doesn't 404?

jun: Yep, I'll update the shortlink to /docs/relnotes/streaming-defaults and push the redirect change.

Emily H: Plan: merge all PRs by noon PT tomorrow, then finalize and publish the relnotes. If anything blocks, post here and tag the release lead. Thanks everyone!
